backgrounds.rule: Empty scene only. No collar, no leash, no dog, no pet, no buckle, no text, no logo, no product. Soft, even light from the upper left. The center of the frame is open, flat and uncluttered, so a product can be placed there. Shot from slightly above. Photographic and realistic. Square.

dogs.rule: Photorealistic, high resolution. The dog wears a plain, unprinted WHITE woven nylon collar, about 1 inch wide, fully visible around the front of the neck and not hidden by fur. The collar has a plain SILVER side-release metal buckle facing the camera, with a flat, blank top face and no text, and a silver D-ring. A plain WHITE woven leash with a silver snap hook clips to the D-ring and hangs straight down in front of the chest. No other collar, harness, tag, bandana or text. Sharp focus on the collar. Natural light.
